newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures mixed, Sept S&P higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures mixed, Sept S&P higher.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures were mixed in early trading, with September Standard and Poor's 500 futures up slightly.
September set a fresh record high in Globex electronic after-hours trade at 911.30, just above the old high Thursday of 911.20.
September was firm but off from that record level in early pit session trade. Selling materialized in the last minutes of Globex to dampen the bullish mood, traders said.
Overall, they said bullish momentum and expiration-related buying continued to support the market.
"I'm still positive the market," one S&P 500 futures trader said early Friday. "September has dropped off a little, but I expect we'll continue the upmove," he said.
One firm pegged September S&P 500 fair value at 9.15 points premium to cash, buy programs at 10.70 points premium to cash or wider and sells at 8.00 points premium to cash or narrower.
Support was at 905.90 and at 899.70, Thursday's day session low. Traders said resistance levels were harder to discern, given the recent resilience of the stock market.
At 0850 CDT/1350 GMT, September was up 1.20 to 908.70.

Traders said choppy trade could materialize around multiple expirations at the end of this week. June S&P 500 futures ended at the close Thursday and settle this morning. Individual equity options, S&P 500 index options and S&P 100 index options also expire at the end of this week.
Concerning June S&P 500 futures, "it was a relatively quiet expiration from what I can see," the trader said.
He said so far it looked like June would settle just slightly above Thursday's 898.30 close.
A final settlement figure was expected later this morning, he said.

At 0916 CDT/1416 GMT, September S&P 500s were up 2.20 points at 909.70, Nasdaq 100s were 4.00 higher at 1001.00, Russell 2000s were down 0.85 points to 400.00, KCBT Value Line futures rose 0.60 points to 799.75, Nikkei 225 index futures fell 105.0 to 20,500.0 and Midcap 400s rose 0.70 point to 294.60.
